name: Spinach RNA aptamer bound to 2ZY fluorophore analog
source: RCSB PDB 4Q9R / NAKB 4Q9R; Spinach RNA aptamer bound to ligand 2ZY in antibody-assisted crystal structure.
notes: Seed RNA-ligand stacking case selected to exercise baseStacking calibration. Structure includes Fab chains; curation should extract the RNA aptamer and ligand 2ZY before docking.
enrichmentNote: Enrichment AUC 0.10 — Vina severely inverted. 2ZY (TO1-Biotin analog, MW ~374) scores worse than small aromatic decoys because Vina hydrophobic terms favour smaller ligands. The G-quartet stacking geometry is not differentiated from generic aromatic docking. Gnina CNN may help; G-quadruplex-specific scoring terms would be needed for full fix.
